name: c07_choice_lock
purpose: Choice Scarf: the first move a holder uses locks it (choicelock); Basculegion's first move is Flip Turn, and switching out ends the lock; Incineroar locked into Fake Out has no move left on its next turn (Champions disables Fake Out, the lock the rest) and Struggles, then switches out by choice (the lock does not trap); x1.5 speed.
